options.name: access_based_enumeration
options.description: If enabled, all folders inside this share are visible to a user based on that individual user access right; prevents the display of folders or other shared resources that the user does not have access to. This option only supported with REST.

options.name: allow_unencrypted_access
options.description: Specifies whether or not the SMB2 clients are allowed to access the encrypted share. This option requires REST and ONTAP 9.11.0 or later.

options.name: browsable
options.description: Specifies whether or not the Windows clients can browse the share. This option requires REST and ONTAP 9.13.1 or later.

options.name: cert_filepath
options.description: path to SSL client cert file (.pem). not supported with python 2.6.

options.name: change_notify
options.description: Specifies whether CIFS clients can request for change notifications for directories on this share. This option only supported with REST.

options.name: comment
options.description: The CIFS share description.

options.name: continuously_available
options.description: Specifies whether or not the clients connecting to this share can open files in a persistent manner. Files opened in this way are protected from disruptive events, such as, failover and giveback. This option requires REST and ONTAP 9.10.1 or later.

options.name: encryption
options.description: Specifies that SMB encryption must be used when accessing this share. Clients that do not support encryption are not able to access this share. This option only supported with REST.

options.name: feature_flags
options.description: Enable or disable a new feature. This can be used to enable an experimental feature or disable a new feature that breaks backward compatibility. Supported keys and values are subject to change without notice.  Unknown keys are ignored.

options.name: force_ontap_version
options.description: Override the cluster ONTAP version when using REST. The behavior is undefined if the version does not match the target cluster. This is provided as a work-around when the cluster version cannot be read because of permission issues. See https://github.com/ansible-collections/netapp.ontap/wiki/Known-issues. This should be in the form 9.10 or 9.10.1 with each element being an integer number. When C(use_rest) is set to auto, this may force a switch to ZAPI based on the version and platform capabilit

options.name: home_directory
options.description: Specifies whether or not the share is a home directory share, where the share and path names are dynamic. ONTAP home directory functionality automatically offer each user a dynamic share to their home directory without creating an individual SMB share for each user. This feature enable us to configure a share that maps to different directories based on the user that connects to it Instead of creating a separate shares for each user, a single share with a home directory parameters can be created.

options.name: hostname
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the ONTAP instance.

options.name: http_port
options.description: Override the default port (80 or 443) with this port

options.name: https
options.description: Enable and disable https. Ignored when using REST as only https is supported. Ignored when using SSL certificate authentication as it requires SSL.

options.name: key_filepath
options.description: path to SSL client key file.

options.name: lambda_config
options.description: Configuration parameters for AWS Lambda proxy functionality. These option and suboptions are only supported with REST.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the CIFS share. The CIFS share name is a UTF-8 string with the following characters being illegal; control characters from 0x00 to 0x1F, both inclusive, 0x22 (double quotes)

options.name: namespace_caching
options.description: Specifies whether or not the SMB clients connecting to this share can cache the directory enumeration results returned by the CIFS servers. This option requires REST and ONTAP 9.10.1 or later.

options.name: offline_files
options.description: Allows Windows clients to cache data on this share. This option is only supported with REST and requires ONTAP 9.10 or later.

options.name: ontapi
options.description: The ontap api version to use

options.name: oplocks
options.description: Specify whether opportunistic locks are enabled on this share. "Oplocks" allow clients to lock files and cache content locally, which can increase performance for file operations. Only supported with REST.

options.name: password
options.description: Password for the specified user.

options.name: path
options.description: The file system path that is shared through this CIFS share. The path is the full, user visible path relative to the vserver root, and it might be crossing junction mount points. The path is in UTF8 and uses forward slash as directory separator.

options.name: share_properties
options.description: The list of properties for the CIFS share. Not supported with REST. share-properties are separate fields in the REST API. You can achieve this functionality by setting C(access_based_enumeration), C(change_notify), C(encryption), C(home_directory), C(oplocks), C(show_snapshot), C(continuously_available) and C(namespace_caching).

options.name: show_previous_versions
options.description: Specifies that the previous version can be viewed and restored from the client. This option requires REST and ONTAP 9.13.1 or later.

options.name: show_snapshot
options.description: Specifies whether or not the Snapshot copies can be viewed and traversed by clients. This option requires REST and ONTAP 9.10.1 or later.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the specified CIFS share should exist or not.

options.name: symlink_properties
options.description: The list of symlink properties for this CIFS share. Not supported with REST, this option is replaced with C(unix_symlink) in REST.

options.name: unix_symlink
options.description: The list of unix_symlink properties for this CIFS share This option only supported with REST.

options.name: use_lambda
options.description: Specifies if AWS Lambda proxy functionality should be used to connect to the ONTAP system. Supported only with REST.

options.name: use_rest
options.description: Whether to use REST or ZAPI. always -- will always use the REST API if the module supports REST. A warning is issued if the module does not support REST. An error is issued if a module option is not supported in REST. never -- will always use ZAPI if the module supports ZAPI.  An error may be issued if a REST option is not supported in ZAPI. auto -- will try to use the REST API if the module supports REST and modules options are supported.  Reverts to ZAPI otherwise.

options.name: username
options.description: This can be a Cluster-scoped or SVM-scoped account, depending on whether a Cluster-level or SVM-level API is required. For more information, please read the documentation U(https://docs.netapp.com/us-en/ontap/authentication/create-svm-user-accounts-task.html). Two authentication methods are supported 1. Basic authentication, using username and password. 2. SSL certificate authentication, using a ssl client cert file, and optionally a private key file. To use a certificate, the certificate must h

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If set to C(no), the SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only set to C(False) used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.

options.name: vscan_fileop_profile
options.description: Profile_set of file_ops to which vscan on access scanning is applicable. REST support requires ONTAP 9.15.1 or later.

options.name: vserver
options.description: Vserver containing the CIFS share.
